newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Amoco raised to buy from hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Amoco raised to buy from hold.

text.p: - McDonald & Co said Monday it upgraded Amoco Corp to buy from hold and raised fourth quarter and 1996 earnings estimates.

Analyst Jack Aydin said in a report that higher oil and natural gas prices were expected to benefit the fourth quarter. He said he raised his fourth quarter estimate to $1.20 from $1.10 and his 1996 estimate to $5.00 from $4.89.
The stock was up unchanged at 77-5/8 in early mornin g exchange trade.
Aydin said his price target was $91 to $94 a share.
